title: Executor Interface and Dry Run
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Executor Interface and Dry Run.
learning_objectives: Explain executor interface and dry run using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for executor interface and dry run
Assess failure and operational limits of executor interface and dry run
concepts_covered: An executor is a swappable tool for applying and recovering faults; dry-run changes nothing.
FaultExecutor requires Apply, Recover, Name; nil executor defaults to DryRunExecutor.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
